name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump announces new Defense Department 'super range' for Montana
changes.summary: During a rally in Montana, President Trump announced that the state will receive a new Defense Department 'super range' for testing advanced weapons and technologies.

changes.title: The Trump Administration and the Shrinking Number of Women in Top Roles
changes.summary: In President Trump’s second term, those heading for the exits, voluntarily or involuntarily, are female officials.

changes.title: Inflation Data Shows Prices Are Up, Worrying Republicans Ahead of the Midterms
changes.summary: The newest inflation report gave Democrats a chance to tie pain at the pump to President Trump’s decisions.

changes.title: 5 Takeaways From a Heated and Personal Maine Senate Debate
changes.summary: Senator Susan Collins, a Republican, and her Democratic challenger, Troy Jackson, disagreed over the war in Iran and President Trump in the third of four debates in a key race.

changes.title: U.S. blasts "embarrassing" complaint against Lebanon's ambassador
changes.summary: The Trump administration sharply criticized a legal complaint filed in Lebanon against the country's ambassador to Washington over her reported outreach to her Israeli counterpart.

changes.title: Breaking down September's CPI report as inflation rises to 3.7%
changes.summary: Inflation accelerated to 3.7% in September as energy costs soared amid President Trump's war with Iran, a new CPI report shows. CBS News reporter Emily Pandise has more.

changes.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico prevail against White House — for now
changes.summary: A federal judge ruled late Tuesday that President Trump cannot ban news organizations from covering him at the White House because he does not like the nature of their coverage - at least, not until the matter goes to a formal trial. (Image credit: Graeme Sloan).

changes.title: Attorney for banned outlets on legal fight over White House press access
changes.summary: A federal judge has once again ordered the White House to restore access for three news organizations President Trump banned last month over their coverage of his administration. The judge ordered full access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico while their legal challenge moves forward. Geoff Bennett discussed more with Ted B.

changes.title: Judge extends order blocking Trump from banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters from White House
changes.summary: A federal judge on Tuesday extended an order blocking President Donald Trump's administration from banning reporters for three news outlets from the White House, a pivotal operational development for the organizations as the extraordinary case — pitting the president against the media that cover him — makes its way thr.
